cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import zipfile, re
z = zipfile.ZipFile('inputs/offer_letter_template.docx')
# find placeholders across all text parts
import collections
tokens=collections.Counter()
for n in z.namelist():
    if n.endswith('.xml'):
        data=z.read(n).decode('utf-8',errors='replace')
        # strip tags to get text
        txt=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',data)
        for m in re.findall(r'[A-Z][A-Z_]+',txt):
            tokens[m]+=1
for t,c in sorted(tokens.items()):
    print(c,t)
"

cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import zipfile, re
z = zipfile.ZipFile('inputs/offer_letter_template.docx')
parts=['word/document.xml','word/header1.xml','word/header2.xml','word/header3.xml','word/header4.xml','word/header5.xml','word/header6.xml','word/footer1.xml','word/footer2.xml','word/footer3.xml','word/footer4.xml','word/footer5.xml','word/footer6.xml']
for n in parts:
    try:
        data=z.read(n).decode('utf-8',errors='replace')
    except KeyError:
        continue
    txt=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',data)
    toks=sorted(set(re.findall(r'[A-Z][A-Z_]{2,}',txt)))
    print(n, '=>', toks)
"

python3 -c "
import json,shutil,subprocess,os,sys,zipfile,re
import fill_docx as F
# monkeypatch-style: build data variants and run core funcs directly
data=json.load(open('inputs/employee_data.json'))

def run(d):
    missing=set()
    with zipfile.ZipFile('inputs/offer_letter_template.docx') as z:
        xml=z.read('word/document.xml').decode('utf-8')
    out=F.process_part(xml,d,missing)
    txt=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',out)
    return missing, 'Relocation allowance' in txt

d2=dict(data); d2['RELOCATION_PACKAGE']='No'
m,kept=run(d2); print('RELOCATION_PACKAGE=No -> kept block?',kept,'missing',m)
d3=dict(data); d3['RELOCATION_PACKAGE']='yes'
m,kept=run(d3); print('RELOCATION_PACKAGE=yes(lower) -> kept block?',kept,'missing',m)
d4=dict(data); del d4['RELOCATION_PACKAGE']
m,kept=run(d4); print('no RELOCATION_PACKAGE -> missing reported:',m)
# ensure RELOCATION never used as fallback: remove PACKAGE but keep RELOCATION=Yes
d5=dict(data); del d5['RELOCATION_PACKAGE']; d5['RELOCATION']='Yes'
m,kept=run(d5); print('no PACKAGE but RELOCATION=Yes -> missing(no alias):',m)
"
